messages:
morgan: quick proposal: introduce a tiny authn-authority service to canonicalize API keys into a signed origin_claim used by routing, quotas, and telemetry. aims: simpler fallbacks, cleaner dashboards.

anika: sounds useful but how is it different from the auth proxy?

morgan: narrower scope. auth proxy does authn+authz+billing. authn-authority only resolves key->canonical origin and returns a signed claim. downstream services verify instead of re-resolving.

sam: latency? extra hop could hurt p99 for hosted API.

morgan: we call it only on first request per connection or when token changes. cache per-key at the edge (10m ttl). steady-state requests skip it.

jules: telemetry improvement would be huge. currently rotations and unbound keys create multiple noisy rows. a deterministic origin_claim (org:123:proj:456:key:hash) unifies joins.

dave: impersonation rules? service accounts can act for projects. need precedence.

morgan: precedence draft: 1) explicit project claim in token; 2) validated impersonation header; 3) key metadata binding -> origin_claim; 4) none -> label "unattributed" and route to sandbox quota with sampled traces.

anika: console UX: ops want quick drill-down when unattributed spikes. add sample traces and validation reason.

morgan: plan a table: origin_claim | attributed_tokens | unattributed_tokens | last_seen | trace_link. trace highlights validation failure.

sam: rollout risk: attribution changes mid-rollout will hurt billing aggregates.

jules: add origin_schema label (v1/v2) and snapshot_id to telemetry so we can diff historical data and backfill.

dave: rollout plan: feature flag at 10% traffic; daily attribution-diff job; alert if billed tokens delta >1% or unattributed_rate jumps.

morgan: canary metrics: attribution_match_rate, unattributed_rate, latency_p50/p99. infra-bot: checklist below.

infra-bot: Deploy checklist:
- create feature flag authn_authority (off by default)
- provision edge cache (redis) per-key TTL 10m
- new telemetry labels: origin_claim, origin_schema, origin_snapshot_id
- dashboards: attribution_match_rate, unattributed_tokens, attributed_tokens_by_org
- quota pipeline: honor X-Origin-Claim header when present, preserve old behaviour as fallback
- sign origin_claim with control-plane KMS and attach X-Origin-Sig header

anika: security: downstream must verify signature to avoid spoofing.

morgan: yes. signature HMAC via KMS; signing key rotation recorded in snapshot_id.

sam: i'll take perf prototyping this week. please open a tiny PR with a sequence diagram and sample headers.

morgan: will do. sample headers:
Authorization: Bearer <token>
X-Origin-Claim: org:123:proj:456:key:ab12cd
X-Origin-Sig: v1:hmacsha256=...

jules: finance wants a query to compute attribution deltas for invoice reconciliation.

dave: add a customer migration notice in console for teams relying on per-key billing.

morgan: will post PR and canary playbook. tagging @sam for perf and @anika for console UX. :eyes:
